method: Actual published /1904/ app at 1280x800, `full`; animation paused after readiness; each stand renders the same held frame with the far-relief swap off (buildings.farRelief.on=false), off again (QA_CONTROL), on, and with the three relief pieces hidden outright (the positive control); triangles from renderer.info, every pixel with gl.readPixels in the same task as the render.
